title.narrative: Safe Spaces, Strong Communities: Enhancing Protection and Living Standards for IDPs in 5 regions of Western Ukraine

description.narrative: ltpgtIn response to anticipated evacuation needs in Ukraine, this project aims to enhance reception capacities in collective sites across the Ternopil, Chernivtsi, Ivano-Frankivsk, Khmelnytskyi, and Vinnytsia regions. Based on comprehensive needs assessments and close coordination with local authorities, our intervention will support the establishment and enhancement of emergency reception facilities for newly evacuated populations, with particular attention to vulnerable groups, including women (60%), children (30%), the elderly, and persons with disabilities (15% of beneficiaries).ltbrgtThe project employs a multi-sectoral approach, comprising two main components. Firstly, we will assist local authorities in the development of new reception capacities and the extension of existing collective sites, ensuring compliance with Resolution 930 standards. This includes furnishing 23 sites with essential furniture and facilities, as well as comprehensively reconstructing two sites to meet Resolution 888 requirements for disability accessibility. These enhancements will provide additional capacity for 1,125 IDPs, including designated areas for families with children and individuals with disabilities.ltbrgtSecondly, the project provides integrated protection services, including specialised child protection support, for both newly evacuated and existing IDP populations. This includes the provision of age-appropriate MHPSS services (separate programs for children and adults), case management for 750 vulnerable individuals (including 250 children), and emergency cash assistance for critical protection cases. All protection activities are designed with a gender-sensitive and disability-inclusive approach, ensuring safe and accessible services for all beneficiary groups. This comprehensive intervention aims to enhance local emergency response capacity while providing dignified and inclusive support for displaced populations, with a particular focus on child protection and disability inclusion across all project components.lt/pgt
